schema.text: When you are held up on a motorcycle or scooter trip, how stressed do you feel?
schema.help: For example traffic jams, crashes or roadworks.

en.#When you are held up on a motorcycle or: When you are held up on a motorcycle or scooter trip, how stressed do you feel?
en.#For example traffic jams, crashes or ro: For example traffic jams, crashes or roadworks.

it.#When you are held up on a motorcycle or: Quando uno spostamento in moto o in scooter subisce blocchi o ritardi, quanto stress provi?
it.#For example traffic jams, crashes or ro: Per esempio code, scontri o lavori in corso.

fr.#When you are held up on a motorcycle or: Quand un retard vous ralentit lors d’un trajet à moto ou en scooter, quel stress ressentez-vous ?
fr.#For example traffic jams, crashes or ro: Par exemple des embouteillages, des collisions ou des travaux.

de.#When you are held up on a motorcycle or: Wie gestresst fühlen Sie sich, wenn Sie auf einer Motorrad- oder Rollerfahrt aufgehalten werden?
de.#For example traffic jams, crashes or ro: Zum Beispiel Stau, Zusammenstöße oder Baustellen.

tr.#When you are held up on a motorcycle or: Motosiklet veya scooter yolculuğunda gecikmeye uğradığınızda ne kadar stres yaşıyorsunuz?
tr.#For example traffic jams, crashes or ro: Örneğin trafik sıkışıklığı, çarpışmalar veya yol çalışmaları.

fa.#When you are held up on a motorcycle or: وقتی در سفر با موتورسیکلت یا اسکوتر معطل می‌شوید، چقدر احساس تنش می‌کنید؟
fa.#For example traffic jams, crashes or ro: مثلاً ترافیک سنگین، برخورد خودروها یا کار در جاده.

hu.#When you are held up on a motorcycle or: Ha motoros vagy robogós úton feltartóztatják, mennyire érzi magát feszültnek?

ar.#When you are held up on a motorcycle or: عند التأخر في رحلة بالدراجة النارية أو السكوتر، ما مدى شعورك بالتوتر؟
ar.#For example traffic jams, crashes or ro: مثل الازدحام المروري أو اصطدام السيارات أو أعمال الطرق.
